test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Decay
solution: The correct answer is '**Growth**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Decay**' is '**Growth**'. • **Decay**: to become bad or be slowly destroyed. (ख़राब होना या धीरे-धीरे नष्‍ट हो जाना) • *Example: the **decaying** carcass of a dead sheep...* • **Growth**: the process of growing and developing. (वृद्धि और विकास) • *Example: A good diet is very important for children’s **growth**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Growth.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Disintegrate**: to break into many small pieces. (टुकड़े-टुकड़े हो जाना, विखंडित होना, विघटित होना) • **Spoilage**: the action or process of spoiling, especially the deterioration of food and other perishable goods. (बिगाड़ने की क्रिया या प्रक्रिया, विशेष रूप से भोजन और अन्य खराब होने वाली वस्तुओं का बिगड़ना।) • **Breakdown**: a time when a vehicle, machine, etc. stops working. (वाहन, मशीन आदि में ख़राबी) 41:T8e9, The correct answer is** 'No improvement required'.**
